shortDescription: The DAX Index dropped 168 points or 0.66 percent on Wednesday to close at 25411 points.Losses were led by Allianz (-3.97%), Scout24 (-3.75%) and Porsche Automobil (-3.70%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Rheinmetall (3.60%), SAP (2.36%) and Fresenius (1.47%).

children: The DAX Index dropped 168 points or 0.66 percent on Wednesday to close at 25411 points.
Losses were led by Allianz (-3.97%), Scout24 (-3.75%) and Porsche Automobil (-3.70%).
Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Rheinmetall (3.60%), SAP (2.36%) and Fresenius (1.47%).

title: The DAX Index Closes 0.66% Lower
